Headline: Convert Lucky Draw: Unlock Mystery Boxes with $1, Win Up to 0.5 ETH
Start: 2026-11-23T10:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-30T10:00:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 0.5 ETH
Smallest threshold (parsed): 1 USDT (buy)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
The Convert Lucky Draw is live for a limited time. Complete designated Convert tasks to unlock Mystery Box draw chances and win ETH tokens or Dual Investment Trial Funds. Start a Convert trade with as little as 1 USDT and enjoy a fast experience with 0 trading fees. Join Now to begin your Convert journey.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 23, 2026, 10:00 – November 30, 2026, 10:00 (UTC)
## How to Participate
Select [Join Now] to complete registration, and you will be considered successfully enrolled.
Complete the required tasks to earn lucky draw chances.
## Event 1: Complete Tasks to Unlock Mystery Boxes
During the event, users who complete the following tasks can earn corresponding chances to open Mystery Boxes. Prizes include ETH, CHECK and Dual Investment Trial Funds. Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. The prize pool is updated daily at 00:00 (UTC).
Reminder: Do not perform frequent operations in a short period of time, as this may trigger Risk Control, affecting the lucky draw result and preventing you from claiming rewards.
Task Type | Requirements
New User Trading Task | Complete your first-ever Convert transaction of at least 1 USDT to receive 1 lucky draw chance (limit 1).
Daily Convert Check-In | Complete 50 USDT in daily convert volume to receive 1 lucky draw chance (once per day)
Convert Trading Task | Reach 500 USDT in Convert trading volume to earn 1 additional lucky draw chance (limited to 1 chance).
Convert Trading Task | Reach 1,000 USDT in Convert trading volume to earn 1 additional lucky draw chance (limited to 1 chance).
Convert Trading Task | Reach 5,000 USDT in Convert trading volume to earn 1 additional lucky draw chance (limited to 1 chance).
Convert Trading Task | Reach 10,000 USDT in Convert trading volume to earn 1 additional lucky draw chance (limited to 1 chance).
## Important Notes
Participants must select [Join Now] on the event page to register and complete Identity Verification to receive rewards.
Rewards will be distributed as ETH tokens, CHECK tokens and Dual Investment Trial Funds. Rewards will be automatically credited to users' accounts after they complete the corresponding tasks. If a reward is not credited, it means the rewards have been fully claimed or the user does not meet the participation requirements.
Task status and data will update within 1–3 hours after you complete the relevant actions.
Market maker, corporate, and institutional accounts are not eligible to participate in this event.
If a user participates in other Gate events at the same time, they will only receive rewards from one event.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
In the event of any discrepancy between the translated version and the English original, the English version shall prevail.
Gate reserves the right of final interpretation.
Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions are unable to use all or part of the services (including participation in this event, games, or competitions). For detailed information on restricted regions, please read the User Agreement.
